name: Iain Fletcher
bio: Iain Fletcher is a British actor best known for his portrayal of DC Rod Skase in The Bill, a role he played from 1994 to 2000. Other television credits include Band of Brothers, Murphy's Law, Family Affairs, Holby City, Waterloo Road, Casualty, Slow Horses, and Armada: Twelve Days to Save England in which he portrayed Sir Francis Drake. He also had recurring roles in Doctors as Gary Lucas in 2013 and 2015, and EastEnders as Councillor Barker from 2025-2026. His film credits are Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man and Fuze. Stage credits include Sam Carmichael in the musical Mamma Mia! in the West End, and Bill Sikes in Cameron Mackintosh's production of Oliver!. He also played the King in The Three Musketeers at Rose Theatre Kingston. In 2021, he was in Hugh Salmon's Into Battle play at Greenwich Theatre.

credits.title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
credits.overview: After his estranged son gets embroiled in a Nazi plot, self-exiled gangster Tommy Shelby must return to Birmingham to save his family — and his nation.

credits.title: Fuze
credits.overview: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

credits.title: The Bill: Target
credits.overview: WPC Ackland finds herself the target of an assassin's bullet.
